notes: Account: ReplyFlow (mid-market sales automation). Primary ask: replace current brittle webhook-based outbound chat agent with a streaming agent that can call tools (CRM update, send email, create calendar events) during conversation. POC was Hosted API (2-week) focused on streaming latency and tool-calling flow. Product lead said, 'We need streaming partials to show the user the reply as it's generated, and tool calls must be synchronous and auditable.' Engineering observed occasional tail latencies when combined tool calls + long context (~2k tokens). Key success metrics: 95th percentile token latency <200ms for streaming path, end-to-end action completion <1s for simple CRM write calls. Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, and KMS-backed key management; prefer SOC2 compliance. Deployment path: start Hosted API for fast time-to-value; if POC metrics meet SLOs, move to Dedicated (reserved) with VPC and SLA. Commercial: mid-market ARR ask ~50k-200k ARR; CFO requested firm quote if Dedicated needed. Blockers: need formal latency SLA language for Dedicated, security scoping for tool connector scopes, and clarity on pricing tiers for high streaming throughput. Linked artifacts: pricing deck and security FAQ in Drive, Fireflies recordings of demo calls, Gmail threads with legal.
